name: cwp-error-log
description: CWP webserver error log - monitors panel and web server errors

name: apache-error-log
description: Apache error log - monitors web server errors and PHP failures

name: mail-log
command: tail -F /var/log/maillog 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'error\|reject\|bounce' || echo 'Mail log not available'
description: Mail log - monitors email errors, rejections, and bounces

name: mysql-error-log
description: MySQL/MariaDB error log - monitors database crashes and errors

name: security-log
command: tail -F /var/log/secure 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'failed\|invalid\|refused' || echo 'Security log not available'
description: Security log - monitors failed login attempts and access denials

name: csf-blocked-ips
command: while true; do csf -g 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'CSF not available'; sleep 60; done
description: CSF Firewall - monitors blocked IPs and firewall activity

name: nginx-error-log
description: Nginx error log - monitors reverse proxy and web server errors

name: php-fpm-error-log
command: tail -F /opt/alt/php*/var/log/php-fpm-error.log 2>/dev/null || tail -F /var/log/php-fpm/error.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'PHP-FPM log not available'
description: PHP-FPM error log - monitors PHP process manager errors

name: varnish-log
description: Varnish cache log - monitors cache hit/miss and errors

name: lfd-log
command: tail -F /var/log/lfd.log 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'blocked\|attack\|exceeded' || echo 'LFD log not available'
description: LFD intrusion detection - monitors blocked IPs and attack detection

name: cwp-panel-log
command: tail -F /usr/local/cwpsrv/logs/error.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'CWP panel log not available'
description: CWP panel error log - monitors admin panel and API errors

name: redis-info
command: while true; do redis-cli INFO stats 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'keyspace_hits|keyspace_misses|connected_clients' || echo 'Redis not available'; sleep 60; done
description: Redis statistics - monitors cache hit rate and connections

name: system-journal-errors
description: System journal errors - monitors all system-level errors

name: mysql-slow-log
command: tail -F /var/log/mysql/slow.log 2>/dev/null || tail -F /var/lib/mysql/*-slow.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'MySQL slow log not available'
description: MySQL slow query log - monitors slow database queries
